result.rationale: The Watch band is defensible on the inputs the formula uses: a single worst line at 40 DPD produces a payment raw of 60.0 (weighted 39.0) and a mild, well-aged capacity-cut story contributes only 3.7, giving 42.7 — inside the 35-60 band and not near the 60 High Risk threshold. However, the score is driven entirely by days-past-due and is blind to two facts in the payment review: total open exposure of ~€527,100 against a €440,000 limit (already over-limit across 6 open invoices), and a trend flag of "insufficient_history" meaning no settled invoice has ever established a payment pattern. The news item is genuinely mild and consistent with the article, though it rests on anonymous sourcing and the company itself calls it a "temporary realignment of production". I would keep the Watch band but attach an exposure caveat rather than treat 42.7 as a comfortable mid-Watch reading.
